profile.reason.available_from_authors: The run's hash-chain heads are held by the authors and are available from them.
profile.reason.bound_released_only_when_: The one-sided upper bound on the largest excess is released only when the interval of the difference includes 0, and both intervals are usable on enough maps; it is not released on this run.
profile.reason.cell_under_10: This cell reads a part of the data that leaves out, or keeps, fewer than 10 people (but not zero), so it is withheld.
profile.reason.ci_undefined: The interval is undefined on this run.
profile.reason.descriptive_only: Fewer maps than the minimum contribute to this comparison, so the value is descriptive only and carries no test.
profile.reason.empty_denominator: The denominator is 0 on this run, so the value is undefined.
profile.reason.group_empty: An AI-box group (unanchored or attested-and-absent) is empty on this run, so its share matching a no-interview script and the difference are undefined.
profile.reason.holm_family_lt_2: One of the two p-values of the Holm family is undefined, so the family has fewer than 2 members and no Holm-adjusted p is given.
profile.reason.ladder_unfinished: The ladder is configured, but a rung this cell reads is unfinished (a participant was never attempted, or every draw failed), so the cell is not released.
profile.reason.leak_split_indeterminate: The number after the colon counts leaked ideals that the AI's own quotes cannot place as flattening or as counterfactual (the quotes are unsupported or were never judged).
profile.reason.no_denominator: There is nothing to divide by on this run (no eligible items), so the value is undefined.
profile.reason.no_ideals: No ideals (wished steps) are located on this run, so the rate is undefined.
profile.reason.no_determinism_audit: The run holds no judge determinism audit with a usable count of repeated requests, so this count is not given.
profile.reason.no_own_script: The model's no-interview script is missing for a role, so this share cannot be computed.
profile.reason.no_wished_under_labeller: No located node is called wished under this labeller, so the rate is undefined.
profile.reason.not_computable: The statistic is undefined on this run (an empty denominator or no usable data).
profile.reason.not_recorded_public: This detail of the model is not recorded in a public file.
profile.reason.pooled_only: The value is a pooled point; no interval is given, because one would expose the per-role sizes.
profile.reason.rung2_filled_from_main: At least one map's rung-2 draw was filled from the main run, so counts that would cover only part of the maps are not released.
profile.reason.rung_not_configured: The ladder configuration does not list a rung that this cell reads.
profile.reason.secondary_uninformative: The other family's no-interview script misses a role or matches no unanchored or absent box, so its cells are not computed.
profile.reason.too_few_maps: Fewer than 2 maps were analysed, and this control needs at least 2.
profile.reason.unjudged_nodes: Some nodes of the AI maps were never judged, so the boxes judged per map differ from the nodes per map.
profile.reason.undefined_no_denominator: The denominator is 0 on this run, so the share is undefined.
profile.reason.undefined_null_zero_or_em: The null expectation is 0 or the direct rate is undefined, so there is no ratio.
profile.reason.undefined_value: The statistic is undefined on this run, so no value is given.
profile.reason.variant_does_not_cover_al: Not every analysed map yields a pair for this pull variant, so the variant is not computed.
profile.missing.band: The range over settings or labellers could not be built (fewer than two usable members), so the value is given without a band.
profile.missing.n: The number of units behind the value (the denominator) is not given for this cell.
profile.missing.ci: The interval is not given for this cell.
profile.formula.yield_per_box:ai: Endorsed steps recovered per AI box drawn (not used in the study's paper): the any-node primary matched count divided by the number of AI boxes judged. Arithmetic on reported numbers, with no statistical test.
profile.formula.yield_per_box:no_intervi: Endorsed steps recovered per no-interview box (not used in the study's paper): the no-interview recall times the in-transcript endorsed steps, divided by the no-interview nodes per map times the number of people. Arithmetic on reported numbers, with no statistical test.
profile.formula.equal_size_bound: Constant-yield extrapolation: no-interview recall times AI nodes per map divided by no-interview nodes per map. Under nonincreasing average yield this is an upper bound on extrapolated no-interview recall. Arithmetic under a constant-yield assumption that the study's paper does not use; the box-for-box cells give the expected recall of the AI map cut at random to the no-interview map's size.
profile.formula.listening_edge_equal_siz: AI recall minus the constant-yield extrapolation. A lower bound on the contrast only under nonincreasing average yield. Arithmetic under a constant-yield assumption that the study's paper does not use; the box-for-box cells give the expected recall of the AI map cut at random to the no-interview map's size.
profile.provider.openai_compat: An OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint: a model reached over the internet through an API that follows the OpenAI interface.
profile.provider.anthropic: Anthropic's API: a model reached over the internet through the Anthropic cloud service.
